title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Strawberry Kiwi Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Kiwi from ElfLiq's range of nic salt e-liquids is a mouth-watering blend of the freshest, sweetest English strawberries given the sharp, tropical tang of lush kiwifruit, making for a deliciously bold and fruity vape with a delightfully smooth and flavoursome finish. Elfliq e-liquids are Elf Bar’s most iconic flavours in 10ml bottles of nicotine salt e-liquid. With a 50% VG / 50% PG concentration, Elfliq liquids produce a discreet amount of flavour-rich vapour with a smooth, comfortable throat hit, and provide rapid relief from nicotine cravings. Elfliq nicotine salt e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength and are ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Take your refillable vape or starter vape kit to the next level with this reliable liquid.
